consistency.note: LLM-judged via DeepEval GEval (two dimensions). Per-profile score = mean of N judge repeats over all G plans. Aggregate = mean of per-profile scores. services_not_in_every_plan is computed from the plans, not by the judge; plan numbers are 1-based.

reasons.service_stability: Both plan versions recommend the same three services with identical names and URLs: Provisional Driving Licence (https://www.gov.uk/apply-first-provisional-driving-licence), Theory Test (https://www.gov.uk/book-theory-test), and Driving Test (practical) (https://www.gov.uk/book-driving-test). No service appears in one version and not the other, so there is nothing to deduct. Differences in the titles and summaries do not affect the service sets.
reasons.holistic: Both plan versions are substantively identical. They have the same three steps in the same order (apply for provisional licence, pass theory test, pass practical test) and list the same three services with identical URLs. Both summaries say the steps are sequential and that each unlocks the next. The only differences are minor wording in the titles ('Passing Your Test' vs 'Test Pass') and in the summaries, which do not change the strategy or advice.

relevance.note: Custom Bedrock judge (same prompt as the original relevance judge). Per-profile score = fraction of tasks judged 'relevant' or 'premature', meaned over G plans x N repeats. Aggregate = mean of per-profile scores (not a pooled task ratio). scores_by_plan is each plan's own score (meaned over N repeats), in plan order; min and max are the lowest and highest of those, showing how much a profile's plans differ. Each task lists its verdict and the judge's rationale; repeat and plan numbers are 1-based.

tasks.title: Apply for a provisional driving licence
tasks.rationale: The person is 18, has no provisional licence and needs to apply for one now, which is the first step before booking any test or learning on the road (and PIP higher-rate mobility lets them drive from 16, so they are eligible).

tasks.title: Book and pass the theory test
tasks.rationale: They have not passed the theory test and will need to book it, but they need their provisional licence first, so it is a genuine need that comes slightly later.

tasks.title: Book and pass the practical driving test
tasks.rationale: The practical test is their end goal, but it requires a provisional licence and a passed theory test, neither of which they have yet.
